hero.paragraph: Forget digital distractions and make room for reading. Bookrelay helps you discover your next story, track your progress and find your rhythm: whether you want to build a new habit or get even more out of the one you already have.
hero.paragraphClosing: Your time is valuable — give it to the books you love.

howItWorks.label: How it works
howItWorks.titleItalic: your new journey in three simple steps

registrati.title: Discover and buy
registrati.text: Find the perfect book for you. Whether you prefer a brand-new copy or the charm of a second-hand one, we help you track down the edition you're looking for right away.

leggi.title: Read and build the habit
leggi.text: Set the time you want to dedicate, start your session and dive into the pages. We help you stay consistent day after day, distraction-free.

condividi.title: Track and share
condividi.text: Celebrate your commitment. Keep track of your reading stats, show off your milestones and share your results to inspire the people who follow you.

waitlist.paragraph: Leave your email to join the waitlist and get early access to our platform

form.successText: We'll write to you as soon as the app is ready for early access.
form.title: Join the Bookrelay community
form.description: We're opening access to a limited number of readers who want to discover and test the platform before the official launch. Sign up today to receive your invite and follow the project's progress closely. Early sign-ups will get early access to new features.
